K1.text: No accounts or sessions; static local-first SPA with IndexedDB only.

K2.text: No privileged server users; the caregiver PIN is a client-side UX lock, not a role (SEC-04, by design).

K3.text: The only entry point, POST /api/tts, is public by design with no auth, origin check or token (SEC-01 only partly mitigated); the deployment currently sits behind Vercel SSO, which is platform protection and not an app guard.

K4.text: No server-side records or by-id reads/writes; all data is in the browser.

K5.text: A 30/min per-IP limit was added (5505c68, SEC-01 partly fixed) but it lives in an in-memory Map per warm instance, not a shared store; MAX_CHARS is still 10,000 and any regex-valid voiceId is accepted.

K6.text: No share or token links exist.
K6.evidence: src/App.tsx routes; no api/ token routes

K7.text: vercel.json still has only git, ignoreCommand and the SPA rewrite; no headers block, no CSP/XFO/nosniff/Referrer-Policy/HSTS (SEC-02 open).

K8.text: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is server-only, fails closed with 503 when unset, sent in a header not a query string; only VITE_TTS_PROVIDER (non-secret switch) is client-side; .env.example holds names only and no env file is tracked. No constant-time compare needed since no inbound secret.

K10.text: Upstream error body, which can echo the user's spoken text, is still logged via console.error (SEC-03 open, minor).

K11.text: No schema-validated env at boot; the single server var is checked ad hoc at use time. Low severity (one var, fail-closed); .env.example does list both vars.

K12.text: No database; e2e already runs against a production build via build && vite preview.

K13.text: No privileged server-side changes to audit.

K14.text: ignoreCommand matches the CLAUDE.md form (previous-SHA diff, repo-root anchored, excludes docs and *.md, falls to build) and per-push deploys are now off via git.deploymentEnabled=false; port 3800 set in config; no cron routes (HEAD 5505c68, 2026-11-10).
